question: Which country shares a sea-line border with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maldives** shares a **sea-line border** with India in the Indian Ocean.
 
• Maldives is a small island country located in the **Indian Ocean,** southwest of India and Sri Lanka.
